reviews.author: Ricky

reviews.title: DDR5 for my new build and fits under Noctua NH-D15 chromax cooler
reviews.comment: Needed ram for my new build and have had very good luck with Crucial parts for many years.  Many will say ram is ram so it doesn't matter but after many many years without issue Crucial is my go to choice when it comes to quality at a reasonable cost.  Part of my build was installing a Noctua NH-D15 chromax cooler on my I9-14900K combined with an ASUS Z790 Gaming Motherboard. This ram fit very well under that massive cooler and is low profile enough to fit with some breathing room but not all ram will work with that huge cooler so this ram is perfect if considering a large CPU cooler. Super easy to install It is working great so far and functions as expected. It runs very cool and is speedy when opening apps or websites. I haven't played with any overclocking yet and really don't plan to since it is already super fast.
reviews.author: Harvey W.

reviews.title: Ordered mistakenly but excellent RAM
reviews.comment: I bought this mistakenly because it was listed near the top under my “ddr5 cl30” search … I am to blame for not catching it (but also, thanks a lot Amazon).  It’s CL36.  It’s fine.  Seems super high quality.  Takes either an A-XMP or EXPO profile with no fuss.  CAS latency is higher than I wanted but this is what I ordered and its specs are clearly stated.  Feels very high quality and fits nicely under a Peerless Assassin CPU cooler although it will be necessary to unclip a fan to gain access but that’s simple.  Great product if you don’t mind CL36!  ***Edit:  I was able to set my cas latency to CL32 with no additional adjustments and it’s stable so now I’m very happy (ymmv!) ****
reviews.author: Hebo Samsonite

reviews.title: Great Performance and Perfect Timing on the Purchase
reviews.comment:
The Crucial Pro 32GB DDR5 RAM Kit (6000MHz, CL36) has been working really well for me so far. Installation was straightforward, and the system has been stable with excellent performance, whether for gaming or general use.
Speeds are solid, and with support for both Intel XMP 3.0 and AMD EXPO, it’s easy to get the most out of the kit without much tweaking. Overall, it delivers exactly what you’d expect from a high-quality DDR5 setup.
One extra plus for me is that I bought it before the recent price increases driven by AI demand, so it ended up being an even better value.
All in all, a reliable and high-performing RAM kit that I’m very satisfied with.
